about.heroSubtitle: Mobile, web, APIs and databases with React Native, Expo, Next.js, Node.js and TypeScript. Modern, secure and scalable solutions.
about.bioP1: Hello! My name is Leonardo Rodrigues and I'm a full stack developer passionate about turning ideas into robust, efficient digital solutions. With over 7 years of experience, I focus on web and mobile development using modern technologies to deliver high-quality products.
about.bioP2: My journey includes companies such as IBM, Banco do Brasil, Banco Sicredi and Sistema FIERGS; I currently contribute to Raiô Benefícios and STV Segurança, participating in the full project lifecycle—from ideation and prototyping to deployment and maintenance. That 360° view helps me deliver complete, effective solutions.
about.bioP3: I'm driven by solving complex problems and growing my skills. Software is more than code—it's understanding the user and building intuitive, impactful solutions. I'm always open to new challenges and to contributing my expertise to innovative projects and collaborative teams.
about.quote: "The more I study, the more insatiable my mind becomes on the subject."
about.quoteAuthor: Ada Lovelace - Mathematician, writer, and author of the first computer algorithm.
